findings: C1 Migrations: 16 feature create-migrations + 1 users ALTER (plus 3 Laravel base) match the design data model — applications has tracking_number unique+nullable+index, status index default DRAFT, all snapshot fields, submitted_at/reviewed_at, composite index (status, created_at); qr_verifications uses nullOnDelete() on permit_id; FK cascade/index actions and decimal(12,2) money columns are present as specified. VERIFIED.

C2 Models: 16 models carry correct constants (Application STATUS_* incl. REJECTED, Payment STATUS_*/VERIFY_*), casts (Payment amount decimal:2 + breakdown_json array, Application datetimes), and relationships. status/tracking_number/submitted_at/reviewed_at excluded from Application $fillable. VERIFIED.

C3 Status machine: ApplicationWorkflowService::TRANSITIONS mirrors the design table exactly (incl. SUBMITTED->REJECTED, UNDER_REVIEW->REJECTED, PAYMENT_PENDING->APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT retry); illegal pairs throw InvalidStatusTransitionException; each transition writes status-history + audit_logs + fires event in one DB::transaction. Unit tests cover 11 legal + 8 illegal pairs. VERIFIED.

C4 Race-safe numbering: TrackingNumberService/PermitNumberService use atomic UPDATE number_sequences SET last_value = last_value + 1 inside a transaction (no lockForUpdate+count); callers retry up to 5 times on UNIQUE collision. RaceConditionTest confirms gap-free increasing numbers. VERIFIED.
C5 QR SVG-only: PermitService::qrDataUri uses QrCode::format('svg')->size(200)->generate() returning data:image/svg+xml;base64. No PNG/imagick/endroid path. VERIFIED.

C6 Notifications synchronous: SendStatusNotification does NOT implement ShouldQueue; NotificationTest asserts the in_app row exists immediately after submit with queue.default=database and jobs table empty. VERIFIED.

C7 Payment: SandboxGateway::initiate only reaches PROCESSING + SANDBOX-{uuid} ref, never PAID; PaymentService::verify is the sole path to PAYMENT_VERIFIED; startPayment guards APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT. PaymentFlowTest confirms pay-alone never releases. VERIFIED.
C8 PermitService::release guards status === PAYMENT_VERIFIED (throws RuntimeException otherwise). PermitTest confirms. VERIFIED.

C9 Private file serving: uploads stored on local disk; served only via policy-gated RequirementController@file (ApplicationPolicy@view) and Bplo controller (@review) through Storage::disk('local')->download. No public URL / storage:link. VERIFIED.

C10 config('permit.*') used for municipality, province, prefixes, valid_months, upload mimes/size, payment mode/methods/webhook_secret, sms driver throughout services and PDF; no hard-coded municipality/prefix/amounts (fee amounts are seeded DB data). VERIFIED.
C11 Role excluded from User #[Fillable]; set explicitly in server code. MassAssignmentTest confirms role is not mass-assignable. VERIFIED.
C12 Routes: 68 routes resolve and match the design Route Map (public, auth guest, applicant role:applicant, bplo role:bplo,admin, admin role:admin, sandbox webhook) with correct throttles. VERIFIED.
C13 RegisterController forces $user->role = ROLE_APPLICANT after a fill that omits role; RegistrationTest confirms role input is ignored. VERIFIED.

C14 CSRF: webhook excluded via $middleware->validateCsrfTokens(except: ['sandbox/payments/*/webhook']); all HTML forms carry @csrf. Webhook authenticates via HMAC (hash_hmac sha256 + hash_equals), returns 404 if not sandbox, 503 on empty secret, 401 on bad/missing signature, 200 on match. VERIFIED.

C15 Tests: 109 passed (323 assertions) covering every critical invariant — no-skip-approval, pay-cannot-release, permit-only-from-PAYMENT_VERIFIED, role-not-mass-assignable, synchronous notifications, SVG-only QR, webhook HMAC 200/401/503, race-safe numbering, QR URL shape, PDF non-empty, PII minimization on /track and /verify. VERIFIED.

C16 'Bongabong' appears in no application source or view — only in .agents planning/review docs and the faker vendor address list (both out of scope). 'Bansud, Oriental Mindoro' used throughout via config. VERIFIED.

C17 No vite()/mix()/npm references in app, resources, routes, config, or composer.json (setup script is Node-free; CDN Tailwind + static public/css/app.css). Only matches are in vendor and planning docs. VERIFIED.
summary: All 17 review criteria pass on independent inspection of the actual code and a live run. php artisan test = 109 passed (323 assertions), vendor\bin\pint --test clean (143 files), route:list = 68 routes, migrations/models/services match the authoritative design. The critical invariants (approval-gated and payment-verified permit release, sandbox gateway that cannot self-verify, atomic race-safe numbering, SVG-only QR, synchronous notifications, role not mass-assignable, policy-gated private file serving, HMAC-signed CSRF-excluded webhook) are all enforced in the service/policy layer and covered by tests. No blocking issues found.
